description: Source code for the MediaScanner class in Android, responsible for scanning directories and files for media content, handling skip lists, and interacting with a client interface.

classes.name: MediaScanner
classes.description: Class responsible for scanning media directories, managing skip lists, and processing files and subdirectories.

methods.name: MediaScanner
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MediaScanner object and loading the skip list.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the locale for media scanning.

methods.name: loadSkipList
methods.description: Loads the skip list from system properties.

methods.name: processDirectory
methods.description: Processes a directory for media files, interacting with a client.

methods.name: shouldSkipDirectory
methods.description: Determines if a directory should be skipped based on the skip list.

methods.name: doProcessDirectory
methods.description: Recursively processes a directory and its contents.

methods.name: doProcessDirectoryEntry
methods.description: Processes individual directory entries (files or subdirectories).
